text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Taking a brilliant 1st place in the Arima 
Kinen and starring as the grand finale of 
this year is none other than myself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is King Halo!! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Praise me more, much more!! I need 
cheers befitting a champion!

...Even so, we've been going back and 
forth like this for over ten minutes now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, Trainer♪ I'm the true 
champion of the Arima Kinen♪

choice_data_list:
You're the star of tonight's live show 
too!

You're the star of tonight's live show as 
well!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! You're right!! I've got to start 
getting ready for the concert soon!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I am King Halo! I'm the Umamusume 
meant to stand center stage at the Arima 
Kinen!

Saying so, King Halo departed with light, 
brisk steps.

...The racetrack staff thanked me 
profusely as I made my way back to the 
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, sounds good to me~.
(Click...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, perfectly! More perfect than ever!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to head to the wings—
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, at a time like this?! *sigh*... How 
oblivious can whoever's calling be—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, it has to be her after all, doesn't 
it? Wait here for just a second.
(Beep...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Mother? My concert is about to 
start, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...To think you'd even win the Arima 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, why the surprised face? Victory was 
only natural for the King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am King Halo. The first-rate 
Umamusume who used to be your daughter."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And one day, I will make the world 
acknowledge you as "King Halo's Mother."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""...My, did you really think you could 
surpass my existence?""

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Someday, I will give you the right to 
beg first-class me to wear your brand's 
racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...What a truly foolish girl."
(Knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King-chan! If we don't head out soon, the 
concert starts in 5 minutes!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way. Is it already that time!? 
Hey Trainer, this is...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nice catch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm off, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""...She's truly been blessed with both 
rivals and a wonderful Trainer, hasn't 
she?""

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'Her voice sounds so genuinely happy. It 
seems she still loves running just as much 
as ever.'"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘...It seems everything I've done was 
completely pointless.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"We may continue to cause you trouble, but 
please take good care of her."
(*Click*... *beep, beep*)

"Should I say 'like parent, like child'? 
Or perhaps 'like child, like parent'..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'll make this the greatest 
stage ever! Everyone, keep up with me!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright. Give it everything 
you've got, on my behalf too~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, now don't say that~. Let's all do 
our best together, okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhhh! King, give it everything you've 
got at center stage for El too, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Awawa...! I wonder if I'll be able to 
dance properly all the way to the end...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Why does it have to be like this, even 
in the wings backstage?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that's just like us, 
though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: “—Now, the curtain rises! Are you ready?”

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: —Right!

Voices that had been scattered until now 
unite into one mighty roar echoing through 
the venue.

The sheer brilliance of the Winning Live 
they performed on this day... goes without 
saying.
